Quick HSK quiz 🐼

熊猫 (xióngmāo) is made of 熊 = bear and 猫 = cat. So what is a "bear cat"?

A) a lion
B) a tiger
C) a panda

Comment A, B or C 👇 Bonus: 猫 (māo) is also a word on its own. Can you guess what it means?

📤 Send this to someone preparing for the HSK
